liveBenchmark.providerLimitations: Semantic Scholar lexical and CORE searches failed in all 40 runs. Europe PMC supplied results. These runs cannot establish full-source recall or compare algorithm versions fairly.
liveBenchmark.judgmentLimitations: 20 biomedical questions use SciFact human evidence annotations. General-topic, distractor and landmark proposals require human review. Unknown results are unjudged, not negative. All default cases are seed-free and contain no DBEF evidence.

dbefTuning.reason: At least three reviewed DBEF-supported cases per split are required; no policy was learned from missing or unjudged evidence.
